stem: This question is about Period 3 elements and their compounds.

parts.text: The atomic radius decreases across Period 3 ($\text{Na}$ to $\text{Ar}$).

parts.text: The first ionisation energy of sulfur is lower than that of phosphorus.

parts.label: (a)(iii)
parts.text: Sodium is a better electrical conductor than phosphorus.

parts.label: (a)(iv)
parts.text: Magnesium is a better electrical conductor than sodium.
